query_selection: use only exact timestamps present in the archived state_control trace; do not synthesize state rows
causal_input: five 5 ms bins x two polarities x 64x64 log1p event counts
camera_calibration: reconstruct CV camera extrinsics from the fixed scene config; require exact resolution/FOV compatibility with the Ours checkpoint calibration
checkpoint_role: old Ours development checkpoint used only as a diagnostic probe; no retraining and no ranking
model_input_boundary: raw ideal-DVS events only; no target GT, depth, or segmentation
evaluator_boundary: target GT joins after forward pass; segmentation/depth are audit-only
